requirements.requirement: There is a person P who is the founder of a company C.
Company C has an online video games division D.
Division D released a video game G in a year Y, where 2000 ≤ Y ≤ 2010.
Video game G was considered, at least until 2019, one of the top-earning games of all time.
Person P graduated from a university U_edu that was founded between 1930 and 1970, inclusive.
Person P has a spouse S; up to 2019, S had no children from the marriage with P.
Person P and spouse S made a foundational gift for the construction of a building B.
Building B was part of a larger complex; as of 2019, B was scheduled to open sometime between 2018 and 2021, inclusive, and was part of a specific university.
Identify the university that building B was part of as of 2023.
